candidates.explanation: For the LOCAL file driver, the serialization transform builds the file URL by prepending appConfig().frontendDomain instead of backendDomain. Local files are served by the backend, so photo URLs in user responses (e.g. /auth/me) point at the frontend host and don't load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the local driver.
